metadata_system.name: MARC Metadata
metadata_system.spec_source: Library of Congress MARC 21 Format for Bibliographic Data, Avram schema (gbv/MARClinter MARCspec.json)
metadata_system.description: MARC 21 (MAchine-Readable Cataloging) is the international standard for bibliographic metadata, maintained by the Library of Congress. Each record consists of a Leader (LDR), control fields (00X), and variable data fields (010-999) with subfields. This entry documents every field, position, subfield, and code value as published in the LoC MARC 21 Format for Bibliographic Data.
